note: City-level only, generated by worldmap.py from a private Google Timeline export. Raw positions, addresses and place names are discarded at import time; coordinates are gazetteer city centres, not the original samples (visit cutoff 75 km, path cutoff 25 km). Dates are synthetic: each city is one day after the previous one in route order, starting at a fixed base; they preserve ordering only and say nothing about real travel dates.
